move: close-up slides push in, focus ring pulses, colour wipe closes loop
how: Three stacked full-bleed slides on a 1080 square, each with a sepia-filtered image, a bottom gradient shade, a centred ring and a caption pair, plus a brand label, a counter and a full-frame amber wipe layer. Each slide owns a third of the duration: its image pushes from scale 1.35 with xPercent +/-4 to 1.05/0 (power2.out) while the ring expands scale 0 to 1.6 and fades (expo.out, 0.9s) and the name and description rise through a mask (expo.out). Slides 2 and 3 reveal with clip-path inset(0 0 100% 0) to 0 (expo.inOut, 0.55s) and the counter text updates. At 90% the amber wipe scales up from the bottom (expo.in), then at 99% its origin flips to the top and it snaps away, handing back to slide one.
adapt: Swap the three images, captions, filters and the wipe colour; add slides by extending per = D/n. Keep the push-in, ring pulse and 0.55s expo.inOut clip reveal.
port: mount(el, shot) builds the slides from shot images; animate(el, shot, D) returns the timeline with per = D/slides and the wipe at 0.9D. The textContent set calls port as-is; scope selectors to el.
caveats: the wipe retracts in the final 0.04s, so the last frame briefly shows slide three instead of slide one
full-frame images with sepia/saturate filters are heavy
